QuestInfo.name: Evil in Sleepywood
QuestInfo.0: You're slowly getting used to life in Maple World, but some kind of evil energy is creeping on you...
QuestInfo.1: You can feel the evil aura from #m105000000#. Go there and investigate.
QuestInfo.2: You asked a person called #p1061019# about the evil aura. Maybe it's from the Cursed Temple...

0.0: You got reliable support with the alliance and you're getting used to your life in Maple World. You were taken aback at first because it was so different from Grandis, but life is pretty similar everywhere.
0.1: Whoa...I just got a whiff of evil. Should I figure out where that came from?

yes.0: You can feel the evil aura from #m105000000#. Go there and investigate.

no.0: Nah. I want to enjoy myself today.

1.0: Hey there, stranger! Can ya give me a hand with something?\r\n#L0##bHold up. I'm sensing some pretty nasty evil around here. Where would it be coming from?#l\n#k
1.1: Evil? We got plenty of that at the Cursed Temple. I mean...it's cursed. Come on.\r\n#L0##bHuh...it feels like the Specters, but different. Ah well. What did you need help with?#l\n#k
1.2: Oh, that. I'm training right now, but things have gone a little wrong. You might be able to help me get back on track.
